newsitem.title: UK: PPL Therap to spell progress on new tech.
newsitem.headline: PPL Therap to spell progress on new tech.

text.p: Scottish genetics and proteins specialist PPL Therapeutics Plc said on Monday that it would announce its progress on enabling technology on February 27.
The study, which involves production of lambs from a variety of cell types, is being jointly done by scientists at PPL and Roslin Institute.
PPL said the study would be published in the 'Nature' publication.
The technology would establish a new method for PPL to make transgenic animals. PPL has filed a patent to protect the new technology.
The Roslin Institute has agreed to grant PPL an exclusive licence for the use of the nuclear transfer technology for making therapeutic proteins.
